sentences.japanese: ビジネスマンの成功は注意深い財政管理の上に築かれる。
sentences.english: A successful business is built on careful financial management.

sentences.japanese: その貿易商は戦後に莫大な財産を築いた。
sentences.english: The merchant accumulated tremendous fortune during the postwar era.

sentences.japanese: その男はおおきな財産を築き上げた。
sentences.english: The man built up a large fortune.

sentences.japanese: その会社はフェアな取引で広く評判を築き上げている。
sentences.english: The firm has built up a wide reputation for fair dealing.

sentences.japanese: インカ族は大きい文明を築いたけれども、彼らには表記法がなかった。
sentences.english: Though the Incas built up a great civilization, they had no system of writing.
